title: derby01: supply drops
description: Fuel cans, spare tyres, rubber bumpers and windscreens turn up on the tarmac as a floating item with a ring and a beam of light. Drive over one to take it: with a mechanic aboard it goes into the spares, without one it is fitted at once. Where they may turn up is the town's drop zones (or anywhere paved); drop pads in the town are fixed spots.

max.description: The most drops lying about at once.

atStart.description: Drops placed when a round starts. At most max.

reach.description: How close (m) a car's middle must come to take a drop.

keep.description: How far a new drop is kept from things, in metres.

edge.description: From the edge of the town.

cars.description: From any car, so nobody gets one dropped in their lap.

types.description: The four kinds of drop. Which kinds exist, and what each gives, are the game's (the screens send them by number); their colours and letters are yours.

fuel.description: A fuel can: +1 can, or fills the tank by a can.

tyre.description: A spare tyre: +1 spare, or replaces the worst tyre.

bumper.description: Bumpers: +3 pieces, or fitted where they matter most.

glass.description: A windscreen: +1 spare, or replaces a cracked windshield.

colour.description: Its ring and beam of light.

ui.description: Its colour on the HUD and in the mechanic's spares.

letter.description: Its letter on the radar screen.
